items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: That was with Ed Lawson, sure. And so I mean I knew what his vision was and I could see it was cool as hell.

ctx.x: That was with Ed Lawson, sure. And so I mean I knew what his vision was and I could see it was cool as hell. He just wasn’t a very good businessman, but it was the right thing to do. He knew how to make a jazz club and he loved the art. And that’s one of the things that’s like lacking in a lot of places that are supposedly jazz clubs or music clubs. The person that owns it really has no idea, they really don’t. They hire a buyer, they do whatever — the end game of the club then reflects that to me. But I had seen…
triple A over there. People enjoy it. We come up with some good deals for people and keep our prices Buffalo real.
